notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-counter-shared-namespace (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): a DCOUNTER read by COUNTER commands (LENGERR RESP2 001 / 002 / 003 once its value no longer fits a fullword) and DEFINE COUNTER / DEFINE DCOUNTER of a name the other command already uses (INVREQ RESP2 202). The program holds its VALUE areas as raw PIC X bytes (an X(8) doubleword, an X(4) fullword), which the translator stores big-endian (#7434). Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: big
scenarios.why: DCOUNTERs at 2**31, 2**32 and 2**33 read by QUERY / GET COUNTER: LENGERR RESP2 001, 002, 003, the low 32 bits in the fullword area

scenarios.name: fit
scenarios.why: a DCOUNTER at 2**31 - 2 read by COUNTER commands while it fits, then walked across 2**31: LENGERR RESP2 001

scenarios.name: dup
scenarios.why: DEFINE COUNTER of a DCOUNTER's name and DEFINE DCOUNTER of a COUNTER's name: INVREQ RESP2 202

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)
